brief:
Radeeh, a security force aligned with Palestinian resistance factions in Gaza, accused a gang led by Ashraf al-Minssi of opening direct fire on Palestinians seeking to depart the group's camps and return to Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The force identified al-Minssi as an Israeli collaborator and said the shootings targeted residents it described as manipulated into joining the gang.

The allegation underscores tensions within Gaza over armed groups operating outside the authority of the territory's de facto governing bodies. Radeeh did not specify when the incidents occurred, provide casualty numbers, or offer additional details about the circumstances of the reported shootings.
